title: Man polishing powder horn outside Lexington church prompts bizarre police response
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Lexington police responded to a report of a man with a gun at Grace Chapel on Friday.
The man, an avid reenactor, was polishing a powder horn, mistaken for a weapon, outside his vehicle.
Officers confirmed no threat existed; the response included locking down the building and closing parts of Worthen Road.

title: Longtime sports analyst Rob Parker not sold that Red Sox will make playoffs
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Rob Parker doubts the Red Sox will maintain their current performance to secure a playoff spot.
Boston Red Sox have a 96% chance of making the playoffs, according to FanGraphs.
The Red Sox hold the second A.L. wild-card spot with a 64-52 record, close to the Yankees.

title: Chad Tracy ‘hopeful’ Wilyer Abreu is back in Red Sox lineup Sunday
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Wilyer Abreu was scratched from Saturday's Red Sox lineup due to leg swelling after being hit in Friday's game.
Red Sox manager Chad Tracy is hopeful Abreu will return for Sunday's game against the Athletics and will assess him in the morning.
Abreu, crucial to the Red Sox with 20 home runs and 62 RBIs, recently contributed key offensive plays despite his minor injury.

title: Red Sox’ latest winning streak ends at 9 games after loss to Athletics
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Boston Red Sox's nine-game winning streak ended with a 7-3 loss to the Athletics on Saturday.
Pitcher Jake Bennett allowed four earned runs over 5.1 innings, contributing to Boston's sixth loss in 38 games.
The Red Sox remain in the AL's second wild-card spot, 1.5 games behind the New York Yankees.

title: Here’s why Gillette Stadium is swapping out its turf surface again so soon after the World Cup
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: Gillette Stadium is replacing its turf again due to an NFL rule requiring specific testing protocols.
The stadium's new turf failed to meet NFL's lab testing protocols, despite passing initial performance tests.
NFL did not grant an updated test; the new turf is same as the one used prior to World Cup.

title: 4 takeaways from the Revolution’s loss vs. Houston Dynamo
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: New England Revolution lost 2-0 to Houston Dynamo at Gillette Stadium, with goals from Guilherme and Agustin Resch.
Newly signed Designated Player Jack Harrison made his Revolution debut in the 55th minute but could not impact the result.
Houston's counter-attacking strategy paid off, sealing victory with a 63rd-minute corner goal by Agustin Resch.

title: Here’s the latest injury updates on Roman Anthony, Adley Rutschman
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Roman Anthony is ramping up recovery from a wrist injury, now hitting off a pitching machine for higher velocity practice.
Adley Rutschman made his first rehab appearance for Worcester Red Sox, catching for five innings and threw out a runner.
Boston Red Sox maintain a nine-game winning streak without Anthony and Rutschman, who are both nearing returns.

title: New on Netflix and more: Top streaming picks for August 2026
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: Streaming recommendations for August 2026 include 'Clueless', 'Eighth Grade', and 'Something's Gotta Give'.
'Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender' premieres on Paramount+ with new adventures and threats to elemental balance.
Boston.com staff highlight 'Star Trek: Strange New Worlds' and 'Ted Lasso' as top TV picks in August.

title: An 8-foot Bigfoot was spotted in Connecticut last month. It’s far from New England’s first.
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Kevin Klimas reported an 8-foot Bigfoot sighting in Voluntown, Connecticut, verified by the Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization.
Since 1994, there have been 126 verified Bigfoot sightings in New England, per The Bigfoot Field Researchers Organization.
Boston University professor Eva Garrett doubts the existence of Bigfoot due to lack of scientific evidence.

title: I will miss my friend Margo, who told me to grieve, but not too much
author: Meredith Goldstein
bullets: Margo Howard, daughter of Ann Landers, was an advice columnist known for her empathetic yet straightforward approach.
Howard was a mentor to Meredith Goldstein, sharing life and advice column insights over 15 years of friendship.
Margo's philosophy centered on finding happiness after loss, advising not to dwell in prolonged grief.
